target_identity_basis: Original RGB, M0 labels and separately recomputed OBB relations; no retrieval output used
mask_basis: Fresh SAM inference on original held-out RGB with projected boxes and visually specified positive/negative points; no model prediction masks
averaging: Mean valid views per query then equal query mean
limitations: M0-derived target semantics share priors with Ours; not independent human truth
SAM has difficulty with holes, fine rods, material changes and occlusion
